info.name: LEADS Attendance API
info.description:
Workforce attendance and task management API for LEADS (aerospace NDT, Singapore),
consumed by the LEADS Attendance Flutter app.

**Conventions**
- Every response uses an envelope. Success: `{ "success": true, "data": … }`.
  Error: `{ "success": false, "error": { "code", "message", "details" } }`.
- Send `Authorization: Bearer <accessToken>` on every route except signup, login, refresh,
  forgot-password, reset-password and health.
- Timestamps are ISO-8601 UTC strings without milliseconds (`2026-10-16T00:54:00Z`); fields ending
  in `Utc` are always UTC.
- Work dates are `YYYY-MM-DD` in the company timezone, `Asia/Singapore`.
- Durations are integer minutes. IDs are integers.
- Pagination: `?page=1&pageSize=20` (max 100); responses include `items, page, pageSize, total`.
- Endpoints that create a resource respond `201`; everything else succeeds with `200`.

**Real-time (Socket.IO)**: connect to namespace `/admin` with `auth: { token: <accessToken> }`
(ADMIN or SUPER_ADMIN; other roles get a `connect_error` of `FORBIDDEN`, missing/invalid tokens `UNAUTHORIZED`).
Server events:
- `attendance:updated`: one `LiveAttendanceRow`
- `overview:updated`: an `Overview`
- `task:updated`: a `TaskSummaryWithAssignee` (with `deleted: true` when the task was deleted)
- `user:pending`: `{ id, name, email, status: PENDING }` when someone signs up
- `leave:updated`: a `Leave` whenever one is recorded, requested, approved, rejected, cancelled or withdrawn

**Roles**
- `EMPLOYEE`: clocks in and out, works on tasks, reads announcements, requests leave.
- `ADMIN`: everything under `/admin` for employees: dashboard, tasks, announcements, attendance
  corrections, leave (record, approve, reject, cancel), and employee accounts (create, approve or reject sign-ups, rename, remove, reactivate).
- `SUPER_ADMIN`: everything an admin can do, plus the only role that may change the office settings
  (`PATCH /admin/office`: name, address, location, geofence radius, default shift start and end, late grace
  minutes, timezone), set anyone's `shiftStart` and `shiftEnd`, and create, promote, demote or remove admins. There is exactly one, created by
  `npm run seed`; it cannot be created, changed or removed through the API by anyone else.
- When an admin attempts a super-admin-only action the API answers `403 FORBIDDEN`.

**Accounts**: users are `PENDING` (signed up, awaiting approval), `ACTIVE`, or `INACTIVE` (removed).
Removing or demoting a user takes effect immediately, including on access tokens already issued.

**Using this collection**
- Set `baseUrl` (e.g. `http://192.168.1.8:5000/api/v1` behind IIS, or `http://localhost:4000/api/v1`).
- Fill in the `*Email` / `*Password` variables, then run a Login request: it stores the token
  (`superAdminToken`, `adminToken` or `employeeToken`) that the other requests use.
- Each request lists who may call it, every field, and every possible response. Open the saved examples
  to see real responses (generated from the API itself; tokens replaced with placeholders).
- IDs in paths and bodies are from the example data; replace them with IDs from your own responses.

request.description:
**Sign in with email and password**

`POST /api/v1/auth/login` · **Who can call:** Public (no token)

Rate limited to 5 attempts per 15 minutes per IP + email (`429 RATE_LIMITED`).
Unknown email and wrong password return the same `INVALID_CREDENTIALS`. Only when the password is right
does the account state show: `403 ACCOUNT_PENDING` (awaiting approval) or `403 ACCOUNT_INACTIVE` (removed).

**Body (application/json)**

| Field | Type | Required | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `email` | string (email) | yes |  |
| `password` | string | yes |  |

**Responses**

- `200` Signed in
- `400` `VALIDATION_ERROR`: body, query or params failed validation (`details.fields` lists them)
- `401` `INVALID_CREDENTIALS`
- `403` `ACCOUNT_PENDING` (sign-up not yet approved) or `ACCOUNT_INACTIVE` (removed by an admin)
- `429` `RATE_LIMITED`

See the saved examples for real request and response bodies.

request.description:
**Employee self sign-up (waits for admin approval)**

`POST /api/v1/auth/signup` · **Who can call:** Public (no token)

Creates an `EMPLOYEE` account with status `PENDING`. It cannot log in (`403 ACCOUNT_PENDING`) until an
admin approves it with `POST /admin/users/{id}/approve`. Admin accounts can never be created here; any
`role` in the body is ignored. Active admins get a `USER_PENDING` push and a `user:pending` socket event.
Rate limited to 5 per 15 minutes per IP + email and 20 per hour per IP (`429 RATE_LIMITED`).

**Body (application/json)**

| Field | Type | Required | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `name` | string | yes | min length 2; max length 150 |
| `email` | string (email) | yes |  |
| `password` | string | yes | min length 8; max length 128; At least one letter and one number. |

**Responses**

- `201` Sign-up received, waiting for approval
- `400` `VALIDATION_ERROR`: body, query or params failed validation (`details.fields` lists them)
- `409` `EMAIL_TAKEN`: an account with this email already exists

request.description:
**Exchange a refresh token for a new token pair**

`POST /api/v1/auth/refresh` · **Who can call:** Public (no token)

Rotates the refresh token: the presented one is revoked and a new one issued.
Presenting an already-rotated or revoked token revokes every refresh token the user holds.
Expired refresh tokens return `TOKEN_EXPIRED`.

**Body (application/json)**

| Field | Type | Required | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `refreshToken` | string | yes |  |

**Responses**

- `200` New token pair
- `400` `VALIDATION_ERROR`: body, query or params failed validation (`details.fields` lists them)
- `401` `UNAUTHORIZED` (missing/invalid token), `TOKEN_EXPIRED`, or `ACCOUNT_INACTIVE` (the account was removed by an admin after the token was issued; end the session and say so)

request.description:
**Clock in from inside the office geofence (EMPLOYEE)**

`POST /api/v1/attendance/clock-in` · **Who can call:** EMPLOYEE

Validated server-side in this order: `MOCK_LOCATION` (isMocked=true), `LOW_ACCURACY`
(accuracy > MAX_GPS_ACCURACY_METERS), `OUTSIDE_GEOFENCE` (haversine distance to the user's office >
radius). Only one open shift and one shift per work date are allowed (`ALREADY_CLOCKED_IN`).
Lateness is computed on the server: late when clock-in is strictly after work date + shift start +
the office's `lateGraceMinutes` (Singapore time; set by the super admin).

**Body (application/json)**

| Field | Type | Required | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `latitude` | number | yes | min -90; max 90 |
| `longitude` | number | yes | min -180; max 180 |
| `accuracy` | number | yes | min 0; Horizontal accuracy in meters. |
| `isMocked` | boolean | yes |  |

**Responses**

- `201` Clocked in
- `400` `VALIDATION_ERROR`: body, query or params failed validation (`details.fields` lists them)
- `401` `UNAUTHORIZED` (missing/invalid token), `TOKEN_EXPIRED`, or `ACCOUNT_INACTIVE` (the account was removed by an admin after the token was issued; end the session and say so)
- `403` `FORBIDDEN`: wrong role (including an admin attempting a super-admin-only action), or not the owner of the resource
- `409` `ALREADY_CLOCKED_IN`: an open shift exists, or today's shift is already complete
- `422` `MOCK_LOCATION`, `LOW_ACCURACY` or `OUTSIDE_GEOFENCE`

See the saved examples for real request and response bodies.

request.description:
**Submit the daily report and clock out (EMPLOYEE)**

`POST /api/v1/attendance/clock-out` · **Who can call:** EMPLOYEE

Atomic: the report insert, task carry-over and shift close commit together or not at all.
The location is always recorded; `MOCK_LOCATION` and `LOW_ACCURACY` are always enforced, the geofence
only when `CLOCK_OUT_REQUIRES_GEOFENCE=true`. Each task in `carryOverTaskIds` must belong to the caller
(`403 FORBIDDEN`) and not be COMPLETED (`400 VALIDATION_ERROR`); it becomes `CARRIED_OVER` and its due
time moves to the same local time on the next work day (Mon–Fri).

**Body (application/json)**

| Field | Type | Required | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `latitude` | number | yes | min -90; max 90 |
| `longitude` | number | yes | min -180; max 180 |
| `accuracy` | number | yes | min 0; Horizontal accuracy in meters. |
| `isMocked` | boolean | yes |  |
| `summary` | string | yes | min length 1; max length 2000 |
| `blockers` | string \| null | no | max length 2000 |
| `notes` | string \| null | no | max length 2000 |
| `carryOverTaskIds` | integer[] | no | default  |

**Responses**

- `200` Clocked out
- `400` `VALIDATION_ERROR`: body, query or params failed validation (`details.fields` lists them)
- `401` `UNAUTHORIZED` (missing/invalid token), `TOKEN_EXPIRED`, or `ACCOUNT_INACTIVE` (the account was removed by an admin after the token was issued; end the session and say so)
- `403` `FORBIDDEN`: wrong role (including an admin attempting a super-admin-only action), or not the owner of the resource
- `404` `NO_OPEN_SHIFT`: not clocked in
- `422` `MOCK_LOCATION`, `LOW_ACCURACY` or `OUTSIDE_GEOFENCE`

See the saved examples for real request and response bodies.
